name: cavemio-status-button
title: Status button
description: Save, Saving, Saved: the spinner opens in, the check draws itself, errors shake, and the label morphs between them.

cavemio.accessibility:
- State changes are announced from a status region beside the button, so the button’s name stays just its label.
- While pending it is aria-busy and ignores clicks, without dimming or losing focus.
- The check is a stroked path that draws itself; the shake uses the Web Animations API. No animation library.
- Installs Text morph alongside it. With reduced motion, states change in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: labels
props.description: Save, Saving, Saved, Try again · Wording per state.

props.name: icon
props.description: – · An icon beside the idle label, e.g. a link icon for Copy link.

props.name: variant
props.description: "primary" · Filled with your brand colour, a thin line outline, or quiet text for toolbars.

props.name: size
props.description: "default" · 36px, or 28px for headers and toolbars (Copy in a code block, Undo in a receipt).

props.name: onReset / resetAfter
props.description: — / 1800 · Called that long after success, to go back to idle.

useCases.title: Save buttons

useCases.title: Copy buttons

useCases.title: Retry and Undo

features.title: Save, Saving, Saved
features.description: A spinner opens beside the label as it morphs to “Saving”, then the label becomes “Saved”, keeping the letters they share.

features.title: A check that draws itself
features.description: On success the spinner blurs out as a check draws in.

features.title: Errors shake and offer a retry
features.description: On failure the button gives a small shake, tints softly red and reads “Try again”.

features.title: No layout jumps
features.description: The width eases to each label, so nothing around the button moves.

features.title: Three looks, two sizes
features.description: Primary, outline or ghost, at 36px or at 28px for toolbars.

features.title: Accessible by default
features.description: While pending it ignores clicks without dimming or losing focus, and state changes are announced beside it.

states.title: idle
states.description: The label and, if you pass one, an icon.

states.title: pending
states.description: A spinner opens in from zero width; the label morphs ("Save changes" → "Saving"). Clicks are ignored and aria-busy is set.

states.title: success
states.description: The spinner blurs out as a check draws itself in 420ms; "Saved". onReset fires after resetAfter.

states.title: error
states.description: A 380ms shake, a soft red tint and an alert icon; "Try again".
